$comment: nana-pi's own map, generated by the generator this repo ships (scripts/code-map.mjs is a shim over templates/typescript/template/scripts/code-map.mjs). Two layers: the apps and the repo's own scripts on top, the packages under them — within a layer imports are free, and nothing in a package may import an app. One 'packages' entry with an empty prefix because nana-pi publishes as ONE package (`pi install git:` installs the whole repo), so a relative import between its directories — packages/nana-knowledge/lib -> packages/nana-pack/lib/display.mjs, apps/desk -> packages/nana-stage/lib/sign.mjs — crosses no published boundary. The six test roots are mapped too, each declared layerExempt: a test module is a module (the 'every module' contract has to reach the suite, or a dropped test header fails nothing), and a test may import across the layer direction. They are declared as roots in their own right so the exemption applies — apps/desk/test and apps/bench/test also sit under the apps/desk and apps/bench roots, which is harmless duplication. 'ignore' names what sits under a root but is outside the map: the three paths that exist only as text INSIDE a test (`apps/bench/test/src.mjs`, `apps/bench/lib/blocks.mjs`, `packages/nana-pack/ts-probe.ts` are fixture sources a test writes at runtime and quotes an import of, which the regex scanner cannot tell from a real edge), the recorded study trees, the browser-only e2e suites, the fixture trees, and templates/ (shipped template SOURCE, whose contract headers name the RENDERED project's paths, not this repo's — so the shims' import of the generator is an external edge). The same reason adds five more: `packages/nana-pack/moduleA.mjs`, `packages/nana-pack/untracked.mjs`, `packages/nana-pack/tests/moduleB.mjs` and `packages/nana-pack/moduleC.mjs` are the resolved form of relative imports quoted inside runtime-map.test.mjs's MM2 fixture source (R-1271), and `packages/nana-pack/moduleMM9.mjs` inside its MM9 fixture source (R-1278), all written to a temp git repository at runtime and never present at these repo paths. The hive vendor folder is ignored because its unmodified third-party release bytes are SHA-256 pinned by hive-assets.test.mjs; adding headers would break those pins. Exemptions are the three bench modules content-pinned by a closed study's fingerprint (apps/bench/studies/tool-profiles-2026-09-08/study.json pinnedSha) — a header would alter committed evidence.
